daily_summary: 当日 vLLM 的 15 个 commit 覆盖多条主线：(1) 多模态处理缓存机制重构，将 cache 从 processor 构造时注入改为调用时动态传入，并让 warmup 使用独立的 processor-only cache；(2) 性能优化包括 sm_120 硬件 tuned matmul 配置、ROCm AITER GDN flat layout 快速路径、DSA Triton kernel 避免运行时 JIT；(3) 多个模型/量化修复：MiMo-V2.5 fp8 qkv sharding、Aria expert 权重布局、ModelOpt MXFP8 预加载权重；(4) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 引入 SWA bounded replay 大型特性，贯通 scheduler / kv-cache / attention 三层；(5) 基础设施改进：KV-event 发布器支持 port 0 绑定并暴露端点、KVConnector abort 安全修复、Triton placeholder 修复、ROCm AITER 版本升级。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日变更中 3 个 commit 对 vllm-ascend 有影响：751f6807 重构多模态 processor 接口（cache 从构造函数移到调用时），涉及 BaseMultiModalProcessor/Registry 签名变更，vllm-ascend 若有自定义 processor 或调用 create_processor(cache=...) 需同步适配；a1bf8ac1 为 GPUModelRunner.prepare_inputs 新增必选参数 num_active_loras，NPUModelRunner 覆写该方法时需同步签名；1dc2d854 的 SWA bounded replay 特性在必然影响路径（kv_cache_interface.py、sched/output.py、scheduler.py）上做了向后兼容的增量扩展（新属性有默认值），但 Scheduler/KVCacheManager 行为语义变化需要回归测试。其余 commit 为 CUDA/ROCm/NVIDIA 特定优化或与 Ascend 无关的构建/测试变更。

commits.comment: 重构多模态处理器缓存机制，将 cache 从 processor 构造参数改为调用时动态传入。核心变化：(1) BaseMultiModalProcessor.__init__ 移除 cache 参数，__call__ 和新增的 get_dummy_mm_inputs 增加 cache 参数；(2) MultiModalRegistry.create_processor 移除 cache 参数，get_dummy_mm_inputs 迁移为 processor 实例方法；(3) ProcessorInputs 增加 cache 字段贯穿 apply 流程；(4) EncoderBudget 将 get_dummy_encoder_profile_inputs 移为成员方法，model_runner 同步改用；(5) renderer 用 _mm_processor_cache / _mm_processor_only_cache 两个独立 cache 替代原 single processor + readonly processor，warmup 只走 processor-only cache 且结束后清理，避免 dummy inputs 污染 sender cache；realtime 模型（Qwen3ASR/Voxtral）通过覆写 _cached_apply_hf_processor 禁用缓存。设计意图是让 cache 成为 per-call 概念而非 per-processor 状态。风险：接口面变化较大，所有继承 BaseMultiModalProcessor 的自定义 processor 和调用 create_processor(cache=...) 的代码都需要迁移。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/multimodal/processing/processor.py 和 vllm/multimodal/registry.py 属于可能影响路径，且发生接口签名变更：BaseMultiModalProcessor.__init__ 移除 cache 关键字参数，__call__ 新增 cache 参数，MultiModalRegistry.create_processor 移除 cache 参数，get_dummy_mm_inputs 从 registry 迁移到 processor 实例。vllm-ascend 若在 vllm_ascend/models/ 下有继承 BaseMultiModalProcessor 的自定义 processor，或以 cache=... 方式调用 create_processor/get_dummy_mm_inputs，将出现 TypeError。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 的多模态模型加载和 profiling 路径（NPUWorker.load_model / profile_run 间接依赖 processor 创建）需要回归验证；若有自定义 processor 相关单测需同步更新 cache 传递方式。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/models/ 下自定义 MultiModalProcessor 的构造与调用测试
NPUModelRunner profile_run 中 get_dummy_mm_inputs 路径测试

affected_interfaces: NPUModelRunner.prepare_inputs (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:366) - overrides GPUModelRunner.prepare_inputs; upstream commit adds a required positional num_active_loras parameter and updates the base execute_model call site to pass it
NPUModelRunner310V2.prepare_inputs (vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py:604) - same 3-arg override, inherits from NPUModelRunner, also dispatched via base execute_model
tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2.py:724 and tests/ut/_310p/test_model_runner_v2_310p.py:376 - call prepare_inputs with the old 3-arg signature
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit [Bugfix][MRV2] a1bf8ac12d9f changes GPUModelRunner.prepare_inputs signature from (scheduler_output, batch_req_state, batch_desc) to add a required num_active_loras parameter, and the base GPUModelRunner.execute_model now calls self.prepare_inputs(scheduler_output, batch_req_state, batch_desc, num_active_loras) positionally (model_runner.py:1712 region). Both vllm-ascend v2 runners call super().execute_model(...), so the base call dispatches to their 3-arg overrides and will raise TypeError on every real (non-dummy) batch under MRV2 (VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1). Fix: 1) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py, change NPUModelRunner.prepare_inputs to (self, scheduler_output, batch_req_state, batch_desc, num_active_loras: int = 0). vllm-ascend does not use FastPrefillHelper/fast-prefill padding (grep shows no usage), so the value can be accepted and ignored, or threaded through if an Ascend fast-prefill path is later added. 2) In vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py, apply the same signature change to NPUModelRunner310V2.prepare_inputs (which forwards to _prepare_inputs_310p and already drops batch_req_state). 3) Update UTs tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2.py and tests/ut/_310p/test_model_runner_v2_310p.py (using the default keeps them passing; add num_active_loras=0/actual value to match upstream). The mm_encoder_model_runner.py change is irrelevant to vllm-ascend (no MMEncoderModelRunner subclass); FastPrefillHelper.prepare's new num_active_loras=0 default is backward compatible and unused by vllm-ascend.
deep_analysis.risk: Hard runtime break for the Ascend MRV2 path: without adapting the two prepare_inputs overrides, base execute_model passes a 4th positional argument and TypeError is raised each step for real batches (dummy/profile runs are unaffected). 310P v2 runner (NPUModelRunner310V2) is affected identically. No data-corruption risk; the fix is a mechanical signature update with a default value. Risk is contained to the opt-in VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER path since vllm-ascend defaults to the v1 runner.

commits.comment: 大型特性：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 编码器侧 SWA bounded replay。核心机制：SWA 组 KV 不参与 prefix caching（SlidingWindowMLASpec.bounded_replay=True 时 prefix_cacheable=False），命中前缀后重新计算命中段尾部 window 个 token 来重建 SWA KV，同时保留 hit 的缓存块。实现贯通多层：(1) KVCacheSpec/UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs 增加 prefix_replay_tokens 属性，SlidingWindowMLASpec 增加 bounded_replay 字段；(2) Scheduler 增加 replay_start 标记、_mark_prefix_replay 方法、本地/远端命中回退逻辑（hit 不超 window 时忽略、远端 hit 截断到整 block）；(3) KVCacheManager.allocate_slots 放宽条件允许 0 新 token 但采纳 computed tokens，SingleTypeKVCacheManager.cache_blocks 对非 prefix_cacheable 组跳过缓存；(4) DeepseekV41ModelState 增加 ReplayAttnMetadata，将 replay_start 传给 SWA metadata builder 并 pad 可缓存组的 replayed slots；(5) 多个 Triton kernel（compute swa indices、combine topk、flashinfer mixed sparse、compressed slot mapping）增加 replay_start 下界；(6) DeepseekV4Attention 按 use_v2_model_runner / PCP 条件决定是否启用。新增 CacheConfig.swa_bounded_replay 开关与大量测试。风险较高，涉及调度与 KV cache 语义变化。

ascend_impact.functionality: 命中必然影响路径 vllm/v1/core/sched/output.py、vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py、vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py 及可能影响路径 vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_manager.py。具体影响：(1) KVCacheSpec 新增 prefix_replay_tokens 属性（基类默认 0），SlidingWindowMLASpec 新增 bounded_replay 字段（默认 False）——vllm-ascend 自定义 KVCacheSpec 子类（AscendMLAAttentionSpec 等）由基类默认值兜底，不破坏编译，但若 merge 时混入 bounded_replay 不一致会触发断言；(2) NewRequestData / Request 新增 replay_start 字段（默认 0），Ascend 自定义调度器（BalanceScheduler 等）继承 Scheduler 时，新 __init__ 会解析 prefix_replay_tokens 并断言多窗口一致；(3) KVCacheManager.allocate_slots 放宽 num_new_tokens==0 条件，分配语义变化，Ascend 的 KV offload 或自定义分配逻辑若依赖旧行为需审查；(4) DefaultModelState.prepare_attn 新增 model_specific_attn_metadata 参数（默认 None），Ascend 自定义 ModelState 若覆写 prepare_attn 且未同步参数会 TypeError。
ascend_impact.testing: SWA bounded replay 的 kernel 和 DeepseekV41ModelState 在 NVIDIA/CUDA 路径，但 scheduler 与 KV cache 的通用行为变更需要 vllm-ascend 回归验证，尤其是自定义调度器与自定义 KV cache spec 的兼容性。

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py — AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec: inherits upstream SlidingWindowMLASpec's new `bounded_replay` field, the `prefix_cacheable` override (`not bounded_replay`), the new `prefix_replay_tokens` property (`sliding_window if bounded_replay else 0`), and the tightened `merge()`/`is_uniform_with_collection` consistency asserts on `bounded_replay`. Its own `merge()` drops the field, so behavior silently diverges from upstream.

vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/model.py — AscendDeepseekV4SWACache.__init__/get_kv_cache_spec and vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/compressor.py — AscendCompressorStateCache.get_kv_cache_spec: upstream DeepseekV4SWACache.__init__ gained `bounded_replay: bool = False`; these construct AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec without `bounded_replay`, silently opting the SWA group out of replay while upstream (V4.1 path) passes `bounded_replay=swa_bounded_replay` (default True).

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/default.py — AscendModelState.prepare_attn: upstream DefaultModelState.prepare_attn gained `model_specific_attn_metadata: ModelSpecificAttnMetadata | None = None` (forwarded to build_attn_metadata); the Ascend override keeps the old signature and never constructs/forwards model-specific attn metadata, so the new replay kwargs plumbing is bypassed on NPU.

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py — build_attn_metadata: upstream now feeds `get_extra_attn_kwargs`-derived kwargs (e.g. `replay_start`) into `attn_metadata_builder.build(...)`; Ascend's fork has the plumbing but no model state supplies it, and any Ascend builder subclassing the changed DeepseekSparseSWAMetadataBuilder must accept `replay_start`.

vllm_ascend/platform.py — NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config: new CacheConfig.swa_bounded_replay=True default and `--swa-bounded-replay` CLI flag require an explicit NPU policy (disable, since the replay worker/meta path is NVIDIA-only).

vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py, dyntra_lb_scheduler.py, scheduler_profiling_chunk.py — RecomputeScheduler/DyntraLBScheduler/ProfilingChunkScheduler keep local copies of `Scheduler.schedule()`, `_update_waiting_for_remote_kv`, and the `allocate_slots` call; they must absorb the new `prefix_replay_tokens` aggregation (`Scheduler.__init__`), `_mark_prefix_replay`, block-rounded ext_tokens, hit-shorter-than-window handling, and `num_tokens_past_hit` semantics once any spec reports `prefix_replay_tokens > 0`.

vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py — is_prefix_cacheable()/KV manager integration: upstream SingleTypeKVCacheManager.cache_blocks now early-returns for `prefix_cacheable=False` specs and KVCacheManager.allocate_slots accepts zero new tokens when computed tokens are adopted; Ascend's managers inherit these and must keep `prefix_replay_tokens=0` for SWA specs to avoid scheduler replay without worker support.
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) In NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config (vllm_ascend/platform.py) or a platform patch, force cache_config.swa_bounded_replay=False on Ascend for DeepSeek V4.1 (mirroring how other NVIDIA-only features are disabled), because the replay path depends on the NVIDIA-only DeepseekV41ModelState.prepare_attn/_pad_replayed_slots_kernel/ReplayAttnMetadata and the shared sparse_swa builder's replay_start handling which the NPU DSA path (AscendDSABackend/AscendDSAMetadataBuilder in vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py) does not implement. 2) In vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py, decide AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec policy: keep bounded_replay False (feature dormant, current behavior) OR implement bounded_replay and update its merge()/is_uniform_with_collection to carry/validate the field; keep is_prefix_cacheable() consistent with the new SlidingWindowMLASpec.prefix_cacheable (not bounded_replay). 3) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/default.py, extend AscendModelState.prepare_attn with `model_specific_attn_metadata: ModelSpecificAttnMetadata | None = None` and forward it to build_attn_metadata for signature parity with DefaultModelState.prepare_attn. 4) When porting DeepSeek V4.1 (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/sparse_mla.py / attention.py / common/ops/cache_utils.py), the NPU metadata builders must accept/forward `replay_start` and the SWA kernels' window bounds must be clamped (or the feature kept disabled). 5) Review vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py, dyntra_lb_scheduler.py, scheduler_profiling_chunk.py custom `schedule()` copies for the new prefix-replay/KV-allocate semantics (they currently bypass `_mark_prefix_replay`), and validate the Scheduler.__init__ assertion that all replay windows agree still holds with Ascend specs (it does today since all report 0). 6) `get_compressed_slot_mapping` gained a `slot_mapping` arg — verify no Ascend caller (none found in vllm_ascend) and that DeepSeek V4's upstream sparse_mla path change is compatible with the NPU model's own compressor/indexer. Add an e2e DeepSeek V4 test on NPU to confirm prefix-caching behavior is unchanged.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. The feature is dormant on NPU today because Ascend SWA specs drop `bounded_replay` (prefix_replay_tokens=0), so no immediate correctness break. Main risks: (a) `CacheConfig.swa_bounded_replay` defaults True and would silently enable replay for DeepSeek V4.1 if ported without adaptation, causing the scheduler to rewind computed tokens and mark SWA groups non-prefix-cacheable while the Ascend worker cannot pad replayed slots or clamp windows -> wrong attention/KV writes or degraded prefix-cache hit rate; (b) AscendModelState.prepare_attn signature drift vs the base class is a latent break if the runner ever starts passing model_specific_attn_metadata; (c) the Ascend custom schedulers' forked schedule() may miss future scheduler semantics, though today all specs report prefix_replay_tokens=0; (d) SlidingWindowMLASpec.merge() now asserts bounded_replay consistency, so any future mixed-bounded Ascend SWA group would raise.

commits.comment: 修复 NIXL KV 传输中 notification-only 请求（完整本地命中或已中止清理）错误上报 receive 完成的问题。根因：NixlPullConnectorWorker.start_load_kv 对所有请求无条件存储 _recving_metadata，但完整本地命中时 num_external_tokens==0，scheduler 从未进入 WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS 状态，不应上报 receive 完成；已中止的清理请求也早已从 scheduler 移除。修复为仅当 meta.awaiting_kvs 为真或存在本地 block 时才存储 metadata。新增测试覆盖 handshake 失败场景下只报告 awaiting_kvs 的接收，并验证 kv_load_failure_policy（fail/recompute）在失败后能正确释放 block 或重置计算状态。另外为 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B 的 PD 分离测试设置 PREFILL_BLOCK_SIZE/DECODE_BLOCK_SIZE=2048 以越过 hybrid page-size 最小阈值。属于精确的 KV 传输状态机修复，风险低。

commits.comment: 为 KV offloading 分层存储引入 back-pressure 检测与缓解机制，是当日最大规模变更（+1464 行，13 文件）。新增 vllm/v1/kv_offload/tiering/backpressure.py，核心组件：EMABackpressureDetector（基于 store 延迟的 EMA，按 s/MiB 归一化以消除 block 大小差异；支持 idle decay 使压力在无完成事件时自然消退、healthy fast-path 旁路策略检查、cooldown 期防抖、warmup 冷启动保护）、DropStorePolicy（压力期全部丢弃）和 ThrottledDropPolicy（按 overshoot 比例限流，高水位 0% 丢弃至 3 倍高水位 100% 丢弃）。SecondaryTierManager 基类新增 backpressure_detector 参数和 block_size_bytes/bp_detector 属性；TransferJob 增加 submit_time 字段，JobResult 增加 transfer_bytes 字段以计算归一化延迟。TieringOffloadingFactory 支持从 tier 配置和顶层 kv_connector_extra_config 按字段优先级合并解析 backpressure 配置。P2P 层显式拒绝 back-pressure（store-latency 检测在 PD 模式下无法 fail-fast，rendezvous 时间使延迟信号不可靠）。新增 706 行单元测试。风险点：SecondaryTierManager 构造签名变更对自定义 tier 实现有破坏性；但 vLLM 核心调度路径不受影响。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。vllm/v1/kv_offload/tiering/ 是 vLLM 通用分层 offload 框架，vllm-ascend 的 kv_offload 为独立实现（NPU-NPU/NPU-CPU），不继承 SecondaryTierManager，也不使用 TieringOffloadingManager。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增/修改测试均针对 vLLM tiering 内部组件。

commits.comment: 修复 ROCm gfx942/gfx950 上 DeepSeek V4 sparse-indexer logits 计算错误/崩溃。根因是 V4.0 C4A（compress_ratio==4）使用 block-flat (NORMAL) cache layout，而 ratio 1/2 使用 16×16 SHUFFLE 布局，原代码对 C4A 走了错误的 AITER SHUFFLE 路径。核心变更：(1) 新增 _indexer_k_is_c4a_block_flat(compress_ratio) 判断函数；(2) 新增 _fp8_paged_mqa_logits_decode_kernel Triton kernel 和 rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits_triton 入口，支持 block-flat 布局的 decode/MTP logits 计算，无 host sync、可安全捕获到 CUDA graph，并通过 N_SPLITS 并行度按 CU 数量自动调节；(3) rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits 增加 compress_ratio 关键字参数并按 gating 分流到 Triton/ref 实现；(4) cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache_triton 增加 cache_layout 参数。新增 186 行测试对比 Triton、AITER、torch ref 输出。纯 ROCm 平台代码，与 CUDA/Ascend 无关。

commits.comment: 将 NIXL KV 传输指标中的 transport-failure 与 KV expiry 分离，属于可观测性改进。核心变更：(1) NixlKVConnectorStats 新增 num_failed_handshakes 计数，reduce() 将 transfer/handshake/notification 三类失败合并为 'Num failed transfers'，KV expiry 单独报告为 'Num KV expired reqs'（即使成功传输数为 0 也输出失败计数）；(2) NixlPromMetrics 中 vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers 现在同时计入 handshake 和 notification 失败，vllm:nixl_num_failed_notifications 保留为兼容计数器（文档明确警告不要两者相加），vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs 保持独立；(3) base_worker 在 handshake done_callback 中记录一次 failed_handshake，_handle_failed_transfer 增加 record_failed_transfer 参数以避免重复计数（KV expiry 路径传 False）；(4) pull_worker 的 send_notif 增加 try/except 记录 notification 失败；(5) push_worker 在 notification 失败和 send 异常路径记录指标，并保留 receive pending 以等待已注册的 WRITE 完成。新增测试验证失败分组、Prometheus 导出和 push 侧不双计。不影响传输行为，但改变指标语义（用户需注意 failed_transfers 口径变宽）。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。NIXL 指标重构属于 vLLM 内置 kv_connector 的可观测性改进，vllm-ascend 使用 Mooncake 连接器和自有指标体系，不依赖 NIXL 的 NixlKVConnectorStats/NixlPromMetrics。

commits.comment: 修复 AsyncLLM 中 n>1 并行采样请求 admission 控制的原子性问题。原实现中每个子请求在 add 前分别调用 check_admission，并发下可能出现部分子请求被接受、部分被拒绝（QueueOverflowError）的中间状态，破坏 n>1 请求的整体性。变更将 n>1 分支（ParentRequest fan-out）重构为：先构造全部 child_requests 列表，调用一次 check_admission(parent_params.n) 预留全部容量，然后批量 output_processor.add_request，再逐个 engine_core.add_request_async；若任一步抛出 BaseException，则调用 abort(parent_request.request_id, internal=True) 回滚所有已添加的子请求。测试新增两个用例验证全有或全无语义（first_n=1/3 参数化）和取消清理（cancel generate 后 abort 全部子请求）。行为变更影响所有平台的 n>1 请求失败路径：QueueOverflowError 现在原子性抛出且不会残留部分子请求。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。AsyncLLM 内部 admission 流程变更不涉及 vllm-ascend 继承的任何接口（Platform/Worker/Attention 等）；n>1 请求现在原子性拒绝或接受，对 Ascend 用户是行为改进而非破坏。
